title: Maximum Genetic Difference Query
goal: Maximize each query value XOR an ancestor label, including the queried node.
strategy: Depth-first traversal keeps exactly the current root-to-node labels in a counted binary trie. Prefer the opposite bit during each query, then remove the node label when leaving its subtree.
